visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair and a white shirt sits on a grey couch. She wears a large red scarf over her shoulders and faces the camera directly with a cheerful expression. Behind her, a yellow Winnie the Pooh and a pink rabbit plush toy are visible against a plain wall. (2) She begins demonstrating a scarf-tying technique, folding the long end of the red scarf into thirds. She appears focused, using her hands to hold the fabric in place while looking at her own reflection or the lens. (3) A series of fast jump cuts show her repeatedly failing to tie the scarf correctly. Her facial expressions shift from concentration to confusion and slight frustration, looking upwards and sighing. She adjusts her jewelry and hair between attempts. (4) A black frame with white text appears briefly, signaling a transition. She returns to the screen holding a different, multi-colored scarf with green, yellow, orange, and brown stripes. She demonstrates a successful bow-tie technique, smoothing the fabric and smiling broadly as cartoon sparkle overlays appear around the scarf. (5) She proceeds to show a second variations of the bow knot with the same multi-colored scarf, carefully wrapping and pulling the fabric through loops. She concludes with a final pose, adjusting the finished bow and looking satisfied.
